title: Spaces around a typed part number do not create a second Part Library entry
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRIM-01) is stocked at {Location-A} only.
  • Its description is {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL trim part").
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-B} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  3. Click New Inventory Part.
  4. Type {Description-A} in Description.
  5. Type two spaces, then {Part-A}, then two spaces in Part Number.
  6. Pick any Category.
  7. Type 10.00 in Cost.
  8. Type 20.00 in Sell Price.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory Search box.
  11. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  12. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  13. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 9: The part is saved with no message about the Part Library (the descriptions match).
  • Step 10: At {Location-B} the part is listed as {Part-A}, with no spaces before or after it.
  • Step 12: Still exactly one entry is listed, {Part-A}: no second entry with spaces was created.
  • Step 13: The entry's detail page shows "Total parts" 2, with Workplace rows for {Location-A} and {Location-B}: the new part was linked to the existing entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R6a, S7-R3, S7-R4, S7-R5, S7-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R6a: “Every route in S11-R6 removes spaces before and after the part number before it looks for an exact match.”
  • S7-R3: “Spaces before and after the part number and the description are removed on save.”
  • S7-R4: “On save, the system looks for a Part Library entry whose number is exactly the number typed, including upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R5: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
